draft.subject: Photographing Harbour Winds at The Example Room.
draft.body: My name is Dan Wright and photography of live performance in NYC is what I do. I work without flash and stay unobtrusive enough that the audience doesn't notice me, and I'm writing about the Harbour Winds date at The Example Room on April 2. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, and my work has also taken me to Lincoln Center and Madison Square Garden. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one hour minimum, and the edited gallery is delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com. I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the evening. I look forward to hearing from you.
